verdict.rationale: DBOS ships an official MCP server that lets an LLM or agent analyze and manage DBOS workflows, so natural-language operation works through a user-supplied AI client. The product has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the Conductor console or CLI, documentation of which management operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can use the DBOS Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to augment your LLM or agent with tools that can analyze and manage your DBOS workflows.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.dbos.dev/integrations/mcp
